name: Haunted Ice Cream
storyline: "Haunted Ice Cream" is a Simon-like game that can be played in one minute. Make ice cream by layering flavors according to the ghosts' orders and earn money. The quicker and mistake-free you make it, the more money the ghosts are willing to pay you. On the other hand, if you fail to make it within the waiting time for orders, they will get angry and leave. Plus, the more ice cream you make, the more chances you have to earn tons of money in power-up mode! Aim for one million yen!
summary: Haunted Ice Cream is a fast-paced time-management and rhythm simulation game where you play as a ghostly ice cream vendor serving spooky treats to restless spirits. Press the right keys in perfect timing to scoop and stack eerie flavors before your possession meter overflows, all wrapped in vibrant neon pixel art and ghostly charm.
